sources.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Sputnik 1 衛星工程史
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：即使通過覆蓋率 0.95 也不接受放行，關鍵失敗需修正重驗或明確核准的風險處置。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Do not release merely at 0.95 pass coverage; the critical failure requires correction/retest or explicitly approved risk treatment. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 從三站接收時刻推斷過境次序，分離軌道證據與無線電振盪器漂移。
related.differenceEn: Infer pass order from three receiving stations and separate orbital evidence from oscillator drift.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學基線 20 條需求，17 條有合格證據，2 條未測，1 條關鍵需求失敗。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：通過覆蓋率=17/20。 結果約 0.85 fraction。通過覆蓋率=已有合格證據的需求數/基線需求數；平均比例不能覆蓋一項關鍵失敗。
分別代入遠離與接近 3000 m/s，畫出兩條預測頻率，再用波峰間隔確認符號。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching baseline has 20 requirements: 17 with acceptable evidence, two untested and one failed critical requirement. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Pass coverage=17/20. Result ≈ 0.85 fraction. Pass coverage=baseline requirements with acceptable evidence/total baseline requirements; an average cannot override a critical failure.
Evaluate recession and approach at 3000 m/s, plot predicted frequencies and confirm the sign from wavefront spacing.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Sentinel-1 雷達地球觀測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：即使通過覆蓋率 0.95 也不接受放行，關鍵失敗需修正重驗或明確核准的風險處置。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Do not release merely at 0.95 pass coverage; the critical failure requires correction/retest or explicitly approved risk treatment. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 從合成干涉相位求視線位移，辨識相位包裹、低相干及大氣混淆。
related.differenceEn: Infer line-of-sight displacement from synthetic interferometric phase and distinguish wrapping, low coherence and atmospheric ambiguity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學基線 20 條需求，17 條有合格證據，2 條未測，1 條關鍵需求失敗。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：通過覆蓋率=17/20。 結果約 0.85 fraction。通過覆蓋率=已有合格證據的需求數/基線需求數；平均比例不能覆蓋一項關鍵失敗。
從往返路徑 2Δd 推導相位，代入 π/2 並換算毫米。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching baseline has 20 requirements: 17 with acceptable evidence, two untested and one failed critical requirement. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Pass coverage=17/20. Result ≈ 0.85 fraction. Pass coverage=baseline requirements with acceptable evidence/total baseline requirements; an average cannot override a critical failure.
Derive phase from round-trip path 2Δd, substitute π/2 and convert to millimetres.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
